insurance_company.description: Full legal name of the issuing insurer or underwriter in the page header beside its logo and registration details; never the insured, policyholder, broker, agent, or payment recipient.

name.description: Name in the labelled insured block.

address.description: All address lines in the same insured block.

customer.description: The labelled Name and Address of Insured block.

start_date.description: Date beside FROM; never Date of Issue.

end_date.description: Date beside TO in the same block.

coverage_period.description: The labelled Period of Insurance FROM/TO block.

total_premium.description: Final Total Premium as a number after removing currency text and leading masking asterisks; not Gross Premium.

policy_number.description: Main value beside Policy No.; not another reference number.

note_type.description: Return debit for Debit Note or credit for Credit Note.
